title: Relative Sort Array
summary: Given arrays arr1 and arr2 where arr2 contains unique elements all found in arr1, sort arr1 so that elements follow the order of arr2, with remaining elements sorted in ascending order at the end.
statement: Given arrays arr1 and arr2 where arr2 contains unique elements all found in arr1, sort arr1 so that elements follow the order of arr2, with remaining elements sorted in ascending order at the end.
constraints: arr2 contains distinct values present in arr1.
Place arr2 values in its order, then remaining values ascending.
hints: A composite sort key can encode both ordering rules.
Map arr2 values to their indices.
Tuple sorting places the entire ranked block first and applies the correct order within each block.
editorial: Tuple sorting places the entire ranked block first and applies the correct order within each block.
